# Analyze and draft

Review `data/opportunities/*.md`, coordinate the analyst, writer and researcher,
and save analysis and drafts under `data/analyses/` and `data/articles/`.
Check that a draft exists under `data/articles/`. Publication requires the
user's approval; this instruction is advisory, not an enforcement mechanism.
